program.section_heading: Orthodontic Assisting Permit - Noncredit Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Demonstrate the steps for selecting, pre-positioning, and curing orthodontic brackets, following approval from the supervising licensed dentist.
Apply appropriate techniques for preparing teeth for bonding.
Demonstrate the safe and effective removal of orthodontic brackets and attachments.
Identify when to refer the removal of bonding material to the supervising licensed dentist.
Demonstrate proficiency in sizing, fitting, and cementing orthodontic bands in compliance with established procedures.
Remove orthodontic bands and excess cement from supragingival surfaces of teeth using a hand instrument, ensuring patient safety and comfort.
Identify, interpret, and demonstrate placement and ligation of archwires in orthodontic appliances.

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours; all unit fields hold hours as printed (course ranges and total 98.50-110.50).

Catalog note: concurrent enrollment in DENTAL 691 and DENTAL 692 is expected. However, DENTAL 692 is not necessary if the student shows proof of a valid 4-hour Ultrasonic Scaling certificate completed within 5 years. DENTAL 692 is recorded as required because it appears under Required Courses; a reviewer should check this waiver.

The description mentions Registered Dental Assistants (RDAs) and Dental Assistants as the intended students (prerequisite audience), not as careers the program prepares for. For that reason no careers are recorded.
Program requires application and prerequisites (active RDA license or six months of dental assistant experience, immunizations, CPR, infection control, Dental Practice Act).
